items.title: Audit and compliance fixes: Garante rows IT-I-01, IT-R-01, IT-R-02, IT-R-03 now cite the specific releases (not the press-room index); IT…
items.content_text: Audit and compliance fixes: Garante rows IT-I-01, IT-R-01, IT-R-02, IT-R-03 now cite the specific releases (not the press-room index); IT-R-02 corrected — the Garante set conditions on 12 Apr 2023 for lifting the ChatGPT limitation, service resumed 28 Apr 2023; FR-R-01 now cites the CNIL sanction decision (SAN-2022-019, via Légifrance) with LINC kept as an additional source; NL-R-01 now cites the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens decision page; EU-P-06, DE-P-01 and FR-P-01 now cite the specific guideline/strategy documents; EU-P-08 corrected to two new Art. 5 prohibitions (ba)–(bb) applicable from 2 Dec 2026. Template: dark-mode active-tab/country-button contrast fixed, general visible-focus rule added, EU-flag non-affiliation disclaimer added (footer and Method), Permissions-Policy meta tag removed (browsers ignore it; it has no meta equivalent). PRIVACY.md: personal-data sentence corrected. No counts changed.
